title: vtc: lobby waiters count as current participants
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:814 sets joinedAt at create even when lobbyState is waiting, so waiters count in activeParticipantCount/maxParticipantsPerCall and match the vtc-wss current-participant definition (joined, not left), receiving in-call events before admission. Rejected participants never get leftAt. Fix: joinedAt set on admission; rejection sets leftAt.
close_reason: Lobby waiters keep joinedAt null until admitted; rejection sets leftAt; vtc-wss current-participant text notes waiters are excluded.
